title: [NSW] Join Energy Australia Flexi Plan for $250 Electricity Credit on First Bill (New Accounts Only) @ Energy Australia
body:
Deal: [NSW] Join Energy Australia Flexi Plan for $250 Electricity Credit on First Bill (New Accounts Only) @ Energy Australia

[IndianWarrior] How are their plans as compared to AGL?
AGL costing arms and legs these days 😭
[shortgum] join directly mean you can not join via affliate sites? e.g. shopback or econnex for extra cashback?
[jackofspade] Energy Australia is not listed at Econnex
[jussie2000] Until first bill…
But it's not clear whether billing period is 90 days or can be changed to 30 days.
[freedomofspeech] Well if you leave you receive a bill.
That will be your first bill from them…
[tenpercent] If you only use $100 worth of electricity do you get the remaining $150 refunded to your bank account?
[linkser] @tenpercent: No, but it carries over to the next bill until it is used up.
"Credit will be applied to your first bill unless the bill charges are less than the credit, when the balance of the credit will be applied to your next bill; and is not transferable or redeemable for cash. We may change or end this offer at any time."
[tenpercent] @linkser: Where did you see that text? I can't find the offer T&Cs anywhere.
[zerokas] They backdate the billing period sometimes to before you joined…
[tenpercent] If you don't use up the credit does it get paid out when you leave?
